class.name: SteamModerationRequest
class.brief_description: Immutable moderation facts handed to the injected authorization policy.
class.description: The publisher passes this exact object to [method SteamModerationPolicy._authorize]. For a reviewed suspension or ban, resolve the report and its target in the game-owned review store. For a removal, check the supplied target. Persist the exact app, operation, report or target, reason, and duration before approving a reviewed write.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the exact moderation action the trusted caller wants to perform.

method.name: get_environment
method.description: Returns the trusted publisher environment selection.

method.name: get_player_id
method.description: Returns the requested target SteamID64 when known.

method.name: get_report_id
method.description: Returns the reviewed Valve report ID for a suspension or permanent ban.

method.name: get_reason
method.description: Returns the requested sanction or removal reason supplied to the policy.

method.name: get_duration_seconds
method.description: Returns the requested suspension duration, in seconds.

method.name: get_evidence
method.description: Returns the report evidence, or null for other actions.

method.name: get_from_unix
method.description: Returns the inclusive UTC report-window start in Unix seconds.

method.name: get_to_unix
method.description: Returns the inclusive UTC report-window end in Unix seconds.

method.name: get_after_report_id
method.description: Returns the exclusive decimal report cursor for a read.
